title: VideoWizard decisions VW-99
how: The operator answers this step on a page, not on a card. 1. If `url` is empty, publish the page with the Artifact tool: `file_path` is `page_file`, the title is `title`, `capabilities` exactly as given, an icon of your choice; then run `vw visuals page --url "<the link it gives>"`. If there is no Artifact tool, or it fails, run `vw visuals next` and show the card instead, and say once that the page is not available. If `republish` is true, the page at the link was published by an older tool: publish it again to the same link (the Artifact tool with `file_path` `page_file`, `url` the link and `capabilities` again, exactly as given), then run `vw visuals page --url` with that link. 2. Send the pictures before the round, when there are any (design/210). For each batch in `picture_batches`: ArtifactData, action "batch", `url` the page's link, `writes` the batch, unchanged. If a batch fails, or a picture stays grey on the page, run `vw visuals page --pictures-again` and send what it gives; if that fails too, stop here, run `vw visuals next` and ask this step in the chat. Then for each list in `zoom_uploads`: the Artifact tool, action "publish", `url` the page's link, `asset` true, `file_paths` the list; save its answer, exactly as it came, to `uploaded_file` with the Write tool, and run `vw visuals page --uploaded "<that file>"`: it gives one more batch in `picture_batches`, sent the same way. If an upload fails, go on, and tell the operator that the large pictures are not available on the page. 3. Write this round to the page with the ArtifactData tool: action "set", `url` the page's link, collection "rounds", doc_id `round`, file_path `round_file`. Type none of its content. 4. Say to the operator `say`, exactly as it is, then the link: add nothing to it, no count and no summary of your own (design/216). Then wait. Do not post the lines in the chat as well. 5. When the operator says done: ArtifactData, action "list", collection `answers_collection`, out_dir `answers_dir`; then run `vw visuals page --record`. If it lists pictures the operator added on the page (`own_fetch`), fetch each one: the Artifact tool, action "read", `url` the page's link, `path` the picture's id, `out_dir` `own_dir`; then run `vw visuals page --record` again: their lines are recorded then (design/210). 6. It prints what was recorded and writes the next round: do steps 2 and 3 again with the new `round` and `round_file`, then follow `then`. An answer the operator gives in the chat instead is recorded with `vw visuals decide`, as before.

help: Each shot on the left has one take to judge. Play it, then select it for the film, ask for another with your words, or reject it. Answer in any order, then say done in the chat.
Claude checked each take first, from frames of it. "Check passed", or the first thing it found; "Go to 5 s" jumps the player to that second. The check marks problems; it never decides.
Under the shot's name are the words spoken during it; the word being spoken is marked as the take plays. No sound is played.
"See it in the film" shows what comes before and after the shot, only to compare. "Details" has everything else about the take.
A shot that has two takes shows them as two tabs. A take answered earlier stays in the list; to change its answer, say so in the chat.
"Make another" orders one more take, made from your words. It is paid; its price is said in the chat when you say done.
This page opens when every take of the film is made and checked.
